LanguageData.RUT_Settings_GasVentsEnabled_Desc: Propane vents self-ignite occasionally and release violently if their pump is torn out while still live.
LanguageData.RUT_Settings_PipeNetworksEnabled_Desc: Propane pipe segments can rupture into a standing jet that only stops when a reachable valve on the same network is closed.
LanguageData.RUT_Settings_VWakeAgitationEnabled_Desc: V-wakes move faster and more alertly while a propane pump is running nearby.
LanguageData.RUT_Settings_SaturationHeistRaidEnabled_: Raids that arrive while your base is heavily gas-saturated re-equip their gunners with vibro/sonic weapons instead of guns.
LanguageData.RUT_Settings_DeflagrationEnabled_Desc: Firing a ranged weapon in a gas-saturated area risks igniting the air itself. This is the riskiest mechanic in this mod — turn it off if it misbehaves.
LanguageData.RUT_Message_GasVentRelease: {0}'s pump was removed while it was still live — the vent lets go all at once!
LanguageData.RUT_PipeValve_ToggleDesc: Open or close this valve. Closing it depressurizes the whole pipe network it sits on.
LanguageData.RUT_PipePump_ToggleDesc: Start or stop this pump. A running pump pressurizes its whole network and agitates nearby propane-native creatures.
LanguageData.RUT_Message_PipeRupture: {0} has ruptured! The jet will not stop on its own — close a valve on this network to shut it down.
LanguageData.RUT_Message_PipeRuptureGoodwill: {0} is furious that a ruptured pipe on their territory was left burning.
LanguageData.RUT_Message_GasFlashover: Flashover! The saturated gas ignites all at once.
LanguageData.RUT_Message_Deflagration: The saturated air ignites at the muzzle!
